## Summary

Victor Zion (also known as Zhayon) is a Software Engineer and Technical Writer. He builds production-grade backend architectures and AI-driven applications while communicating complex technical systems through clear developer documentation and technical essays.

## Selected Projects

- **techDNA** (https://www.techdna.app): Full-stack career discovery platform combining a digital literacy assessment with a 40-question psychometric personality engine. Built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Vercel AI SDK, Google Gemini, and Paystack.
- **Volta** (https://volta-dun.vercel.app): Real-time token streaming poetry engine with semantic analysis and stanza revision. Built with FastAPI, Python 3.12, Google Gemini API, Server-Sent Events, and SQLite.
- **Fathers** (https://early-fathers.ai.studio/): Contemplative web platform curating ancient wisdom and literature from the Fathers of the Early Church. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cormorant Garamond, and Web Share API.
- **Redocly Developer Documentation** (https://demo-3d453564.mintlify.app/): Mintlify-hosted API documentation portal generating three-panel API docs from OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.
- **Anthropic Messages API Docs** (https://creatorsgrowth.mintlify.app/home): Comprehensive developer guide on integrating Claude into production via the Anthropic Messages API.
- **Sage AI Assistant** (https://sage-ai-docs.streamlit.app/): Document Q&A assistant powered by Gemini AI and FAISS vector search.

## Publications & Writing

- **Stop Writing "Fix Stuff": A Better Way to Commit** (https://medium.com/@victorzion1/stop-writing-fix-stuff-a-better-way-to-commit-36a2651aa2db): Disciplined Git commit hygiene for engineering teams.
- **AI Engineering vs ML Engineering: Not the Same Job** (https://medium.com/@victorzion1/ai-engineering-vs-ml-engineering-not-the-same-job-22a1c7e92619): Practical breakdown of workflows, tooling, and responsibilities between AI application engineers and ML researchers.
- **Idempotency: The Backend Concept That Saves You at 3 AM** (https://medium.com/@victorzion1/idempotency-the-backend-concept-that-saves-you-at-3-am-66e01b00e99d): Architectural guide to designing idempotent APIs and background workers that safely prevent duplicate writes.
